thread:
anna: Kickoff: customer asks for compact cost trace + error attribution widget for console launch. Quick sync on scope cuts?

mohit: TL;DR: need dashboard smallcards, trace hook adapter, sampling policy, retention 30d for cost metrics. Can we defer error heatmap v2?

lee: deferring heatmap ok. Concern: trace hook at 99th p99 span attach increases egress and CPU. Propose adaptive sampling: `sampling: "adaptive:base=1%,burst=10%"`

sara: For SLOs we need baseline: 100ms median, 750ms p95 for rendering. Also telemetry budget: 2% of outgoing RPS for traces.

anna: Customer asks: show per-route token cost and example query breakdown. That's in MVP? @dara?

dara: Design: smallcards + drilldown modal is doable. But drilling into trace requires link to tracing UI; can be soft link initially.

mohit: Launch criteria proposal: (1) dashboard smallcards + per-route cost, (2) trace hook adapter w/ sampling, (3) error attribution table + basic root cause tags, (4) canary on 10% accounts, perf SLOs met on canary.

lee: Ops: we can canary with dedicated pool, need autoscale config and throttling fallback. Also add fallback to cheaper quantized model for heavy analytic jobs.

sara: Instrumentation: need a sampling toggle per-customer + aggregated counters. Counters retention 90 days? Cost tradeoff: 90d increases storage x2.

mohit: Decision: reduce counters retention to 30d for launch; add backfill plan for enterprise customers.

anna: Action items: @mohit create rollout PR, @lee add sampling config, @dara finalize modal, @sara list metrics & alerts. I'll prepare customer comms.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to canary cluster at 2026-04-10T16:00Z for 10% rollout :rocket:

anna: quick poll: ok to cut error heatmap v2 to post-launch? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:

mohit: +1

lee: +1

dara: +1
